parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, primarily made of glass with a thin plastic or metal frame around it.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output from a computer or other device, serving as the main interface for viewing content.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed to the base but may tilt or swivel slightly depending on the mount design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic, providing stability and support for the screen.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the screen and may allow for tilt or rotation adjustments to improve viewing angles.
parts.Movement_description: The base remains stationary on a surface, though it may allow the screen to pivot or tilt.
